Interface GameDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
NoGameDAO, SqlGameDAO
public interface GameDAO
Data-access interface for match history persistence.

The production implementation is SqlGameDAO. A match row is created when the game starts and finalised (with timestamp, player count, and scores) when the game ends.

  • Method Details

    • createMatch

      int createMatch() throws SQLException
      Inserts a new match row and returns the generated match ID.
      Returns:
      the auto-generated match ID
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the insert fails

    • deleteMatch

      void deleteMatch(int gameId) throws SQLException
      Deletes the match row with the given ID. Called when all players leave the lobby before the game ever starts.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the match ID to delete
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the delete fails or no row is found

    • saveMatch

      void saveMatch(int gameId, int playerCount, List<String> nicknames, List<Integer> scores) throws SQLException
      Finalises a match by recording its timestamp, player count, and per-player scores. Upserts player rows as needed.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the match ID created by createMatch()
      playerCount - number of players who participated
      nicknames - player nicknames in the same order as scores
      scores - final prestige-point totals
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the transaction fails (automatically rolled back)

    • getLeaderboard

      List<DBRecord> getLeaderboard(int playerCount) throws SQLException
      Returns the all-time leaderboard for matches of the given player count, ranked by cumulative score descending.
      Parameters:
      playerCount - filter for matches with this exact number of players
      Returns:
      ordered list of DBRecords with dense rank
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails
